Asha: Quick micro-poll while I eat my sad desk salad 🍴 — three tiny things: editor for a 3-min fix, lunch pick, and funniest demo codename. Reply with letter/number or emoji. No pressure. :sunglasses:

1) Best editor for a 3-minute tweak?
```
a) nano/micro
b) VSCode quick window
c) vim (fast fingers)
```

2) Lunch today (we'll order for the team if enough votes)
```
1) Korean BBQ bowl
2) Falafel wrap
3) Burrito (build-your-own)
```

3) Whacky demo codename for our tiny toy model
```
I) ToastyTurtle
II) LatteLoop
III) DebugDuck
```

Liam: b + 3 + II — VSCode for copy/paste, burrito, LatteLoop is hilarious :coffee::taco:

Priya: a + 2 + III — nano + falafel, DebugDuck is my spirit animal :duck::eggplant:

Mateo: c + 1 + I — vim reflexes, BBQ bowl please, ToastyTurtle just warms my heart :turtle::fire:

Asha: tally so far: editors a=1 b=1 c=1 ; lunch 1=1 2=1 3=1 ; codename I=1 II=1 III=1. Wildcard suggestions welcome. :chart_with_downwards_trend::grin:

Liam: wildcard for codename: IV) SnackBot — only answers with snack recs :cookie:

Priya: IV) "SnackBot" votes for me too — everything else is biased by my hunger :drooling_face:

build-bot: Reminder: Reaction votes recorded. If ordering, react with :+1: on the final lunch option before 12:05pm PT. :robot_face:

Mateo: tagging @here — if you want burrito, falafel, or BBQ, react now. I'll place the order at 12:10.

Asha: closing light poll at 12:05 — will post final order and codename in #random-summary. Thanks y'all :pizza::tada:
